claims.text: The as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA is ductile.
The as-cast alloy contains an FCC matrix and a B2 phase.
The as-cast alloy has no significant long-range order.
The as-cast alloy has relatively smooth phase boundaries.
Aging AlCoCrFeNi2.1 at 600°C produces near-stoichiometric Ni3Al-like L12 ordered domains within the FCC matrix.
Aging at 600°C produces jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries.
Near-stoichiometric L12 ordering maximizes the antiphase-boundary energy.
High antiphase-boundary energy raises the barrier to dislocation cross-slip.
Suppression of cross-slip forces dislocations into planar slip.
Planar slip concentrates stress at serrations of jagged B2/FCC interfaces.
Stress concentration at boundary serrations causes boundary cracking and brittle fracture at 600°C.
Aging at 750°C reduces the L12 order parameter.
Reduced L12 order at 750°C lowers the antiphase-boundary energy.
The lower antiphase-boundary energy at 750°C facilitates cross-slip.
At 750°C, jagged boundaries act as ductile transition zones and no longer serve primarily as crack-nucleation sites.
Reduced ordering and facilitated cross-slip restore ductility at 750°C.
Elongation follows a non-monotonic trend, dropping substantially after aging at 600°C and recovering after aging at 750°C.
The brittle state has a direct correlation between peak L12 order and the density of jagged boundary serrations.
An L12 order parameter above approximately 0.8 produces the brittle regime when the boundary is jagged.
An L12 order parameter below approximately 0.4 preserves ductility even when boundaries are jagged.

contradictions.description: The initial state is described as having an FCC matrix, whereas the baseline calls the matrix disordered A2; A2 denotes a disordered BCC structure and therefore cannot simultaneously describe the same FCC matrix.

The hypothesis states that jagged boundaries remain at 750°C and become ductile transition zones, while the predicted outcome says jagged serrations will be absent or less pronounced at 750°C. The 'absent' alternative is incompatible with jagged boundaries serving as the proposed transition zones.
